list.title: Procedures
list.description: Catalog of what you do: duration, price, follow-up, consent form and supply kit.
list.name: Name
list.suppliesCount: {count, plural, =0 {no supplies} one {# supply} other {# supplies}}
list.emptyDescription: Add what you do most to book faster and deduct supplies from stock. Start with one of these:

form.description: Duration and price fill in the new session in the calendar; the supply kit comes ready when you record the visit.
form.name: Name
form.returnHint: Leave blank if there is no scheduled follow-up. Suggestions:
form.consentHint: Text the patient reads and accepts before the procedure. No promises of results.
form.kitDescription: Stock products and the default quantity per session (e.g. toxin 50 U). You can adjust it when recording.
form.kitNoProducts: No products in stock yet. Add your supplies in Stock to build the kit.

errors.category: Choose a category from the list.
errors.duration: Duration must be between 5 and 480 minutes.
errors.price: Enter a price of zero or more.
errors.returnDays: Follow-up must be between 1 and 730 days, or left blank.
errors.tooLong: One of the texts is too long. Shorten it and try again.
errors.quantity: Invalid quantity. Use numbers, with a comma or dot for decimals (e.g. 1.5).
errors.product: Product not found in this practice's stock.
errors.duplicateProduct: The same product appears twice in the kit. Combine the quantities in a single line.
errors.alreadyRecorded: This session already has the procedure recorded.
errors.nothingToRecord: Enter the quantity of at least one supply.
errors.photoStage: Choose whether the photo is before, during or after.

stock.quantity: Invalid quantity for the stock deduction.
stock.product: One of the products is no longer in stock.
stock.lot: The selected lot was not found.
stock.expired: The selected lot is expired. Choose another one or use automatic.
stock.insufficient: Not enough stock for one of the supplies. Check the quantities or record the lot entry.

schedule.hint: Fills in duration and price; you can adjust them.

session.returnEvery: Follow-up in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
session.consentEmpty: This procedure has no consent form. Write it in the procedure settings.
session.consentPending: The patient has not accepted this version of the form yet.
session.recordDescription: Check supplies and quantities. The stock deduction is linked to the patient and to this session.
session.kitEmpty: This procedure's kit is empty. Enter the supply used below or build the kit in the procedure settings.
session.costHint: Cost based on each lot's price (or the product's, if the lot has none).
session.returnDate: {date}, {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} after this session.

patient.historyEmpty: No sessions with a procedure yet.
patient.photosDescription: Before, during and after, by procedure and area. Only the clinical team sees these photos.
patient.photoHint: JPG, PNG or WebP. The photo is resized on your device before upload.
patient.clinicalConsent: The patient authorized clinical use of this photo (record and follow-up).
patient.marketingHint: Separate, express authorization from the patient for social media and materials. Without it, the photo stays in the record only.
patient.photosEmpty: No clinical photos yet. Take the before photo at the first visit to compare later.
